mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wm_refresh_token (user_id, jti_hash, issued_at, expires_at, user_agent, ip_addr) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{jtiHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{userAgent}, #{ipAddr})
mapper.select: SELECT rt_id, user_id, jti_hash, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, replaced_by, user_agent, ip_addr, created_at FROM wm_refresh_token WHERE jti_hash = #{jtiHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE wm_refresh_token SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE jti_hash = #{jtiHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE wm_refresh_token SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userSeq} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE wm_refresh_token SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_refresh_token WHERE user_id = #{userSeq} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()

SELECT u.user_seq AS USER_SEQ, u.user_uid AS USER_UID, u.user_name AS USER_NAME, u.user_status AS USER_STATUS, u.email AS EMAIL, u.phone AS PHONE, u.require_second_auth AS REQUIRE_SECOND_AUTH, u.allow_duplicate_login AS ALLOW_DUPLICATE_LOGIN, ua.user_auth_seq AS USER_AUTH_SEQ, ua.auth_identifier AS AUTH_IDENTIFIER, ua.password_hash AS PASSWORD_HASH, ua.auth_status AS AUTH_STATUS, ua.failed_login_count AS FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT FROM wm_user_auth ua INNER JOIN wm_user u ON u.user_seq = ua.user_seq AND u.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE ua.auth_type = #{authType} AND ua.auth_identifier = #{authIdentifier} AND ua.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE wm_user_auth SET failed_login_count = 0 , last_auth_at = NOW() WHERE user_auth_seq = #{userAuthSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT allow_duplicate_login FROM wm_user WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT u.user_seq AS USER_SEQ, u.user_uid AS USER_UID, u.user_name AS USER_NAME, u.user_status AS USER_STATUS FROM wm_user u WHERE u.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND u.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wm_otp_verification (user_seq, otp_code, otp_type, send_type, send_target, fail_count, max_fail_count, verified_yn, expired_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{otpCode}, #{otpType}, #{sendType}, #{sendTarget}, 0, #{maxFailCount}, 'N', #{expiredAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT otp_seq AS OTP_SEQ, user_seq AS USER_SEQ, otp_code AS OTP_CODE, otp_type AS OTP_TYPE, send_type AS SEND_TYPE, send_target AS SEND_TARGET, fail_count AS FAIL_COUNT, max_fail_count AS MAX_FAIL_COUNT, verified_yn AS VERIFIED_YN, expired_at AS EXPIRED_AT, verified_at AS VERIFIED_AT, created_at AS CREATED_AT FROM wm_otp_verification WHERE otp_seq = #{otpSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE wm_otp_verification SET verified_yn = 'Y', verified_at = NOW() WHERE otp_seq = #{otpSeq}
